messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: On-call rotation: Diego is primary for Ember starting today; Oskar is off rotation.
- [2026-03-02] standup/ember/2026-03-02: Reminder from the Ember team: page Oskar Lind for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-11-27] standup/cinder/2025-11-27: As of today Diego Alvarez is on the Ember team; Cinder loses a pair of hands. Yuki takes the Cinder pager from Diego, who is leaving the team.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-09-16] handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder today; Oskar Lind wrote up the handover doc for Diego.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-scheduler: Handover: as of today scheduler moves from the Ember team to the Dune team. Oskar walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-10-24] standup/cinder/2025-10-24: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2025-03-31] standup/ember/2025-03-31: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2025-09-05] standup/cinder/2025-09-05: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2025-02-27] standup/cinder/2025-02-27: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.
- [2025-07-21] standup/ember/2025-07-21: Ember runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: The Ember team is a one-person team at the moment: Oskar.
- [2026-02-11] handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags: The Ember team handed the flags service to the Dune team today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-06-06] standup/cinder/2025-06-06: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-10-16] standup/cinder/2025-10-16: The Cinder team has moved to the third floor.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.

Question: Which note recorded Diego's move to Ember, and when?
